Deprecation Notice:
The Marketing Version 202511 (Marketing November 2025) will be sunset on November 16, 2026. We recommend that you migrate to the latest versioned APIs to avoid disruptions. For information on all the supported versions, refer to the migrations documentation.
If you haven’t yet migrated and have questions, submit a request on the LinkedIn Developer Support Portal.

Company Page Boost lets an authenticated member turn an eligible post on a Company Page they can manage into a sponsored ad on behalf of the sponsoring organization. This page documents the full Company Page Boost workflow: checking boost status, initializing boost setup, previewing targeting and pricing, and creating the boost. For the equivalent member workflow, see Member Post Boost.

All requests use the versioned REST base URL https://api.linkedin.com/rest/, require a member access token for a member who can manage the specified organization, and must include the Linkedin-Version header set to 202610 or a higher available version, and the X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0 header.

Rows.Text: Retrieve boost status for posts in the specified sponsoring organization's Company Page Boost context.
Initialize boost setup, preview a boost, and create boosts for the sponsoring organization's posts, including retrieving boost status.

Blocks.Text: The organizationBoostStatus API returns boost status for up to 50 posts in the Company Page Boost context. Use this finder to determine whether each target post can currently be boosted on behalf of a sponsoring organization and, when it cannot, why it is ineligible.
This endpoint is organization-scoped. Pass the sponsoring organization in the organization query parameter, and use an authenticated member who is allowed to act on behalf of that organization.

Blocks.Text: The organizationBoostInit API initializes boost setup for a Company Page post. It returns the post's boost eligibility and lifecycle state, the sponsored account that will be billed, whether billing is already configured for that account, and an optional maximum total budget. This action can create a sponsored account or billing configuration as a side effect when one does not already exist.
This endpoint resolves Company Page boost context from the authenticated member and the organization URN. Use a member access token for a member who can manage the specified organization.

Rows.Text: The Company Page post to initialize. Supported URN types are urn:li:ugcPost:{id} and urn:li:share:{id}.
The sponsoring organization for the boost. The URN format is urn:li:organization:{id}.
Optional sponsored account URN. Used with campaignUrn in the manage-ad flow.
Optional sponsored campaign URN. When provided, the request loads the existing boost campaign instead of initializing a new boost (manage-ad flow).
The post this boost setup applies to.

Boost eligibility or lifecycle state. Returned only in the manage-ad flow, when the request includes campaignUrn. Values: ELIGIBLE, INELIGIBLE, IN_REVIEW, CURRENTLY_BOOSTED, PREVIOUSLY_BOOSTED, SCHEDULED.
The sponsored account billed for the boost. If no eligible account already exists, the API creates one and returns it. The URN format is urn:li:sponsoredAccount:{id}.
Whether the sponsored account already has a payment method configured.
The maximum total budget allowed for the boost, when available.
The sponsored campaign URN, when the boost backend returns one.
ISO 4217 currency code for the sponsored account. Omitted when unavailable.
Boost objectives available for the post and boost context.
The initially selected objective. This value can fall outside availableObjectiveTypes.
The default campaign schedule. Pass this value as runSchedule when you call hydrate and post.
Default start time, in epoch milliseconds. Omitted when unavailable.
Default end time, in epoch milliseconds. Omitted when unavailable.

Blocks.Text: When billingConfigured is false, the sponsored account does not yet have a payment method on file. Direct the organization's admin to add a payment method in LinkedIn Campaign Manager before calling boostPost — this API does not return a billing-setup redirect URL. Once billing is configured, subsequent boost initialization calls for the same account return billingConfigured: true.

Blocks.Text: The organizationBoostHydrate action previews targeting, forecast, and pricing for a hypothetical boost campaign in the Company Page Boost context. This is a read-only preview endpoint: it does not create sponsored entities, and it returns the echoed request inputs together with any available targeting, forecast, budget suggestion, and pricing data.

This endpoint runs in Company Page Boost context. Include the organization URN in the request body and call the API as a member who can manage the specified organization and its promoted post. Internally, the resource uses the presence of organization to route the request through the organization boost context.

Rows.Text: Sponsored account URN to bill for the hypothetical boost. Must be a urn:li:sponsoredAccount:{id} value.

Advertiser objective for the hypothetical boost. Supported values: CREATIVE_ENGAGEMENT, WEBSITE_TRAFFIC, LEAD_GENERATION, VIDEO_VIEW, BRAND_AWARENESS, WEBSITE_CONVERSION, WEBSITE_VISIT, ENGAGEMENT, JOB_APPLICANT, TALENT_LEAD, CONVERSATION_STARTER.
Total budget to preview. Omit it to receive suggested budgets only.
Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the budget.
Campaign schedule to preview. Use the defaultRunSchedule returned by init.
End time, in epoch milliseconds. Must be after runSchedule.start.

Short description of the post or product being boosted. The backend uses this to compute the preview.

Blocks.Text: The organizationBoostPost API creates a boost for an eligible Company Page UGC post or share on behalf of an organization. This write action creates a sponsored campaign group, sponsored campaign, and sponsored creative, and returns the URNs of the newly created ads entities.

This endpoint is organization-scoped. The authenticated member must call it for an organization they can manage, and the account parameter must identify a sponsored account that is valid for that organization.

Use the account returned by a prior boost initialization call for the same post. This endpoint externalizes the target post, organization, sponsored account, objective, total budget, and optional call-to-action settings; other campaign settings rely on server-side defaults.

Rows.Text: Target post to boost. Supported URN types are urn:li:ugcPost:{id} and urn:li:share:{id}.
Sponsored account that funds the boost. This must be a urn:li:sponsoredAccount:{id} URN.
Organization that owns the Company Page boost context. Use the format urn:li:organization:{id}.

Boost objective. Supported values: CREATIVE_ENGAGEMENT, WEBSITE_TRAFFIC, LEAD_GENERATION, VIDEO_VIEW, BRAND_AWARENESS, WEBSITE_CONVERSION, WEBSITE_VISIT, ENGAGEMENT, JOB_APPLICANT, TALENT_LEAD, CONVERSATION_STARTER.
ISO currency code for the budget, for example USD.
Campaign start time, in epoch milliseconds. Use the defaultRunSchedule returned by init.
Campaign end time, in epoch milliseconds. Must be after runSchedule.start.
Audience for the boost, such as the suggested audience returned by hydrate.

Optional call-to-action label for the creative. Supported values: APPLY, DOWNLOAD, VIEW_QUOTE, LEARN_MORE, SIGN_UP, SUBSCRIBE, REGISTER, JOIN, ATTEND, REQUEST_DEMO, SEE_MORE, UNLOCK_FULL_DOCUMENT, BUY_NOW, SHOP_NOW.

Blocks.Text: The organizationBoostCampaign resource deletes an existing Company Page Boost campaign. This action deletes the campaign; it doesn't pause it. Campaign authorization and deletion restrictions are enforced by the boost service.

Rows.Text: The ID of the boost campaign to delete, passed in the resource path.
The sponsored account URN associated with the campaign.

Blocks.Text: A successful request returns 204 No Content with no response body.
